If `true`, `KeyType` must be `ECSECPrimeRandom` and `KeySize` must be 256 or 384. Setting this key to `true` is supported as of macOS 14 on Apple Silicon and Intel devices that have a T2 chip. Older macOS versions or other Mac devices require this key but it must have a value of `false`.
